note: Remote Alberta Parks campground on a spruce-forested point on Wolf Lake, 20 km east of Edson on Hwy 16 then 53 km south on Wolf Lake Road. Boat launch, fish-cleaning station and boat-trailer parking at the day use; informal trails. Some sites were closed after a past wildfire. Bring drinking water; no firewood on site. --Claude
